{{Navbar-Global Gas Infrastructure Tracker}}
'''VG Pipeline Saltville Link P-25 Line''' is an operating natural gas pipeline in the United States.<ref>{{Cite web|url=https://www.eia.gov/naturalgas/pipelines/EIA-NaturalGasPipelineProjectsAug2026.xlsx|title=eia.gov|website=eia.gov|access-date=2026-11-04}}</ref><ref>{{Cite web|url=https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/1394074/000095012907006163/h52385exv99w1.htm|title=sec.gov|website=sec.gov|access-date=2026-11-04}}</ref>

==Location==
The pipeline runs from Saltville Gas Storage facility, Virginia to near Radford, Virginia.<ref>{{Cite web|url=https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/1394074/000095012907006163/h52385exv99w1.htm|title=sec.gov|website=sec.gov|access-date=2026-11-04}}</ref>

==Project Details==
*'''Capacity: '''40 MMcf/d<ref>{{Cite web|url=https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/1394074/000095012907006163/h52385exv99w1.htm|title=sec.gov|website=sec.gov|access-date=2026-11-04}}</ref>
*'''Length: '''72 mi<ref>{{Cite web|url=https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/1394074/000095012907006163/h52385exv99w1.htm|title=sec.gov|website=sec.gov|access-date=2026-11-04}}</ref><ref>{{Cite web|url=https://www.eia.gov/naturalgas/pipelines/EIA-NaturalGasPipelineProjectsAug2026.xlsx|title=eia.gov|website=eia.gov|access-date=2026-11-04}}</ref>
*'''Diameter: '''8 in<ref>{{Cite web|url=https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/1394074/000095012907006163/h52385exv99w1.htm|title=sec.gov|website=sec.gov|access-date=2026-11-04}}</ref>
*'''Status: '''Operating<ref>{{Cite web|url=https://www.eia.gov/naturalgas/pipelines/EIA-NaturalGasPipelineProjectsAug2026.xlsx|title=eia.gov|website=eia.gov|access-date=2026-11-04}}</ref><ref>{{Cite web|url=https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/1394074/000095012907006163/h52385exv99w1.htm|title=sec.gov|website=sec.gov|access-date=2026-11-04}}</ref>
*'''Start year: '''2001<ref>{{Cite web|url=https://www.eia.gov/naturalgas/pipelines/EIA-NaturalGasPipelineProjectsAug2026.xlsx|title=eia.gov|website=eia.gov|access-date=2026-11-04}}</ref>
